reviews.title: Terrible customer service and completely unreasonable refusal to refund priority fee.
reviews.text:
I paid an additional fee for priority delivery, but the original driver cancelled due to an accident. I completely understood that unforeseen circumstances happen and had no issue with this.

However, I was then required to place an entirely new order, resulting in a significantly longer wait. I reasonably requested a refund of the priority delivery fee on the second order, given that the service I had originally paid extra for had not been delivered.

This was refused on the absurd grounds that the second order had arrived within its delivery window, completely ignoring the fact that I had only needed to place a second order because the first had failed.

Despite being understanding about the original circumstances, my reasonable request for compensation for the wasted priority fee, inconvenience and additional waiting time was dismissed.

The issue wasn’t the driver’s accident — it was the company’s complete lack of accountability, fairness and customer care afterwards. Extremely disappointing service.

reviews.title: 1.3 rating on TrustPilot
reviews.text: While GoPuff does have a great business model in that your order is being picked from a location that houses all of their stock, delivers very late into the night, and charges a premium for it, there are some MAJOR issues that I run into every single time, which are varied. Today, I ordered a GoBag of nearly expired beverages (yes, on purpose due to the “discount”), valued at $23, but the discount price that I paid for these beverages was equivalent to the total had I just bought them individually from the app. So, it’s a scam. In the past, I have received incorrect items, ice cream sandwiches that melted and were then re-frozen, so technically they weren’t melted upon arrival…just very gross. I’ve had a delivery person not want to walk up to my front door, a total of 20 feet, 3 steps, at 3PM. Today, my delivery lady was a man. This is a small fraction of the problems, but the biggest reason I would urge anyone to avoid GoPuff is that the customer support is AWFUL. They are there to tell you, in essence, “Sorry, not sorry. Now kindly F off”. It’s as horrendous as Uber Eats customer “support”, and because the two are now “integrated”, I assume the representatives go through the same type of training to ensure that customers with legitimate issues get zero resolution. You need not take my word for it: take a look at their 1.3 rating on TrustPilot, or google to see that I’m in good company. I’m done with GoPuff and the headache associated with it.

reviews.title: NO AI
reviews.text: I have been a loyal customer and advocate for GoPuff for YEARS. At this point I have likely spent thousands of dollars on this app. Every friend and family member knows how often I order GoPuff. And now I am about to cancel my Fam membership and delete because of this AI bot that had been implemented. NOT EVERYTHING NEEDS AI. You're wasting water and contributing to climate destruction, for what? So we can check out sixty seconds faster? See everything that was ALREADY in the browse menu in a fashion show instead of just scrolling? I'm genuinely sick about this. We're rapidly declining into an Idiocracy/Wall-E planet, and AI is partly to blame. I cannot exaggerate how confused and angry and disappointed I am. I used to love browsing the app and letting friends order fun things, but now whenever I accidentally hit the button for the ROBOT I am filled with rage and despair. How much money was spent adding this totally unnecessary bot? How many human jobs will be affected? And no option to even turn it off? Include an option to disable the AI bot and make to menu screen the way it was, or many people will be done with GoPuff forever. We are sick of having AI forced on us. Humans NEED to THINK. We NEED to be able to make decisions. People are already stupider now for it, and yes—it IS that deep.

reviews.title: Why I Switched From Gopuff to Dashmart After Four Years
reviews.text:
Today marks the last time I will ever use Gopuff—and that’s historic for me! For the past four years, I’ve ordered from Gopuff up to three times a day because I work from home. My loyalty started after a negative DoorDash experience in another state, and I found Instacart’s payment holds excessive. But now, I’m officially switching to Dashmart for good.

Gopuff consistently receives what seems like the worst products from manufacturers—from damaged paper towels to expired food. Their customer service hasn’t helped at all, despite repeated complaints. I’ve received ripped open paper towels more times than I can count, sometimes with bugs inside. My breaking point was ordering an emergency plunger and receiving one covered in feces. I actually wondered if this was a message from the facility in my city, especially considering the drivers have thrown items at me and even threatened to withhold my deliveries because I didn’t tip once.

Delivery drivers often bring dogs along, placing them on top of open products, and their attitude is consistently rude. The customer service is outsourced, making communication nearly impossible, and I’ve gotten sick multiple times from their expired foods. My friends and family have constantly urged me to stop using Gopuff, citing their outrageous prices and poor service, but I felt trapped since other apps struggle to locate my address. Today, though, I’m done. I won’t be a customer any longer, and I encourage others to explore better options too
